card.line: Ziph was a city in the hill country of Judah, and its nearby wilderness is where David hid from King Saul.

moments.title: David Hides in Ziph
moments.text: David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph. Saul searched for him day after day, but God would not deliver David into his hand.

moments.title: Jonathan Strengthens David
moments.text: While David was in Horesh in the Wilderness of Ziph, Jonathan came and strengthened his hand in God. He told David he would be king, and the two made a covenant before the LORD.

moments.title: The Ziphites Tell Saul
moments.text: The Ziphites went to Saul and said David was hiding among them. They promised to deliver him, and they went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Saul and his men then went to seek David.

moments.title: Saul Returns with Three Thousand
moments.text: The Ziphites again told Saul where David was hiding. Saul took three thousand chosen men down to the Wilderness of Ziph to search for him.

moments.title: Rehoboam Fortifies Ziph
moments.text: Rehoboam strengthened the fortifications of Ziph and other cities of Judah and Benjamin. He put officers in them, with supplies of food, oil, and wine.
